verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference API platform, so background automation is a fair axis. Its only relevant evidence is the Batch API, which runs thousands of chat completions offline as asynchronous jobs, and canary traffic trials gated by Reflex results before a provider switch. Both are background or automated processing, but neither is a user-configurable automation that runs on its own. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered automations, autonomous background agent runs, workflow configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
